hooks.name: graveyard-packet-on-spawn
hooks.description: Inject this caller's current QWK packet as starting context.

hooks.name: graveyard-guard-status
hooks.description: Block bbs_set_status calls the status machine forbids (e.g. running -> done).

hooks.name: graveyard-guard-writes
hooks.description: Block writes to paths mapped to a lock this caller does not hold, and any write before ACK.

hooks.name: graveyard-milestone-on-stop
hooks.description: Post a MILESTONE with git diff --stat and heartbeat held locks.
